name: RAG QA Starter
description: Question answering over a product knowledge base. Ships a source document so retrieval quality (precision, recall) can be measured separately from answer quality.

default_config.system_prompt: Answer the question using only the retrieved context. Quote figures exactly as written. If the context is insufficient, reply: 'The provided context does not contain this information.'

metric_notes.context_recall: The single most diagnostic RAG metric — if recall is low the model never had a chance.
metric_notes.context_precision: Low precision with high recall usually means top_k is too large or chunks are too small.
metric_notes.correctness: End-to-end answer quality once retrieval has done its job.
metric_notes.answer_relevance: Detects answers that summarise the context instead of answering.
metric_notes.latency: Retrieval adds latency; this keeps the trade-off visible.
